name: Visual Enhance: Day/Night
description: A visual-enhancement display mode using the engine's render pipelines. Version 1 adds dynamic day/night lighting: the overworld is tinted by time of day (cool blue at night, warm at dawn and dusk, neutral at midday), following the in-game clock if world_clock is installed or your real local time otherwise. It colors only the world, leaving menus crisp. Toggle intensity with hotkey 7 (OFF / SUBTLE / MEDIUM / STRONG). No custom shader, no engine files touched, no maps edited.
